name: chpu
description:
The phrase as a ЧПУ (a human-readable URL part).

Latin letters and digits go in lower case, cyrillic in translit, accented letters as plain ones. The spaces and signs between words become one «-», none at the edges.

Example: semkit read --text "Диван-кровать 2 м!" --text "Щётка  ёж" chpu write -
-> divan-krovat-2-m; schetka-ezh

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
